title: Efficient Generation of Diverse Cooperative Agents with World Models
abstract: arXiv:2506.07450v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: A major bottleneck in the training process for Zero-Shot Coordination (ZSC) agents is the generation of diverse partner agents via Population-based Training (PBT). Prominent PBT methods, such as Cross-play Minimization (XPM), can be very computationally expensive and sample inefficient, as the training objective requires sampling multiple types of trajectories, in particular the need of Mixed-Play (MP) trajectories to mitigate self-sabotage in cross-play. Each partner agent in the population is also trained from scratch, despite all of the partners in the population learning policies of the same coordination task. In this work, we propose that simulated trajectories from the dynamics model of an environment can drastically speed up the training process for XPM methods. translated_title: 基于世界模型的高效多样化协作智能体生成
translated_abstract: arXiv:2506.07450v2 公告类型：替换 摘要：零样本协作训练智能体的一个主要瓶颈是通过基于种群的训练生成多样化的伙伴智能体。著名的基于种群的方法，如交叉博弈最小化方法，计算开销可能非常巨大且样本效率低下，因为其训练目标需要采样多种类型的轨迹，特别是需要混合博弈轨迹来缓解交叉博弈中的自我破坏问题。此外，种群中的每个伙伴智能体都是从零开始训练的，尽管所有伙伴学习的都是同一协作任务的策略。在这项工作中，我们提出利用环境动力学模型生成的模拟轨迹可以大幅加速交叉博弈最小化方法的训练过程。我们提出了XPM-WM，一个通过学习到的世界模型为交叉博弈最小化方法生成模拟轨迹的框架。我们展示了使用模拟轨迹的交叉博弈最小化方法消除了……（摘要原文至此截断）
tldr: 该论文提出XPM-WM框架，利用学习到的世界模型生成模拟轨迹来替代真实环境采样，从而大幅加速交叉博弈最小化方法的训练，降低计算开销并提升多样化协作智能体生成的样本效率。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes XPM-WM, a framework that leverages a learned world model to generate simulated trajectories for Cross-play Minimization, drastically accelerating the training of diverse cooperative agents while reducing computational cost and improving sample efficiency.
